name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to cortical surface - Freesurfer computations
summary: Computes per-ROI statistics of cortex-mapped diffusion measures with FreeSurfer mri_segstats and anatomical measures with mris_anatomical_stats for a FreeSurfer aparc or an optional surface parcellation, and outputs merged CSVs.
description: Scales very small measures (mean below 0.005) by 1000 with Connectome Workbench, then for each hemisphere runs FreeSurfer mri_segstats on every cortex-mapped measure and mris_anatomical_stats (thickness, surface area, volume, curvature) within each parcel of the FreeSurfer aparc and, if given, a surface parcellation. Results are merged into one CSV (also saved as cortex.csv). Use it to obtain parcel-wise cortical diffusion and morphometry tables for group analyses. Needs a cortexmap and the FreeSurfer subject directory of the same subject; a surface parcellation also needs its left and right white surfaces.

inputs.description: Path to the cortexmap datatype folder
Optional surface parcellation (left and right .annot files with a label table); converted onto the FreeSurfer white surface and summarised in addition to the aparc.
Optional left and right white surface meshes on which the surface parcellation is defined; required with parc_surface.
FreeSurfer subject directory of the same subject; provides surfaces and the aparc annotation used for statistics.

outputs.description: Csv files for each summary statistic and parcellation
Derivatives generated during run for debugging

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable on the compute resource.

failure_modes.message: stats computations failed somewhere. please check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.fix: Check the job log and raw derivatives for the failing step.
